items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: We had Lil Hardin on piano. We had Johnny Dotson on Clionet.

ctx.x: They fired Jimmy Polar. Oh yeah. I remember that. You see, I'll give you the lineup of the band we left fairly well with. We had, uh, we think from the piano. We had Lil Hardin on piano. We had Johnny Dotson on Clionet. Joe Oliver on trumpet. Nora Dutre on trombone. Uh, we had, uh, Jimmy Polar on violin. Uh, we had a band. And I was on the bass. Ram was on the drums. Okay. Then, they want to turn this boy loose, give him a note. Didn't give him no notice. Just fired him.

items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: And Lil Little played the piano for me.

ctx.x: Was on the clarinet. And Lil Little played the piano for me.

items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: So, I went over with the band, and, I asked for the music. So, Eddie Garland was the one who called the numbers, and Lawrence Dewey was the one who used to knock them off, you see.

ctx.x: that's true, no, I was watching, I was watching the volume meter, oh, I see, mm-hmm, I watched the volume meter occasionally,

so, well, I imagine about the, after I'd been there about a month, this band from New Orleans came in the store one day, and this woman booked musicians and singers, in different cabarets, and, and, dance halls, too, so, they came in there, to see this woman about getting a job for her, and that was this band from New Orleans, with Eddie Garland, Roy Palmer, Lawrence Dewey, Sugar Johnny, and, who's playing drums? Tubby Hall, I guess.
I was going to say one of the hall boys.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: I put her in a place of band.

ctx.x: Mutt was living for a while too. Mac was there.

I mean, Mutt was there. Yeah. Yeah. I still, I still, uh, may share. And Mutt said, I said, Mutt, I can get you John too. Mutt said, well, I'll go far to St. Louis and I'll jump at St. Louis. He left with St. Louis, but, oh, Bessier just left right away. Well, he played up the deluxe with me. He decided, what's doing? Mutt come back. See? Well, I got Mutt with me. Johnny was very sick, you know. He was sick, you know. I was there. He stayed with me. Then I got Joe. Finally, Nora Dutrae comes through town. He's…
